title: Payout submitter / settlement worker
goal: Actually pay every committed holder leaf, once, with crash-safe resume.
steps: After a distribution is verified, funded, and both distribution-signer/verifier signatures are present (WP-13), call HolderSettlement.payEntitlement once per leaf (per chunk if chunked)
Add retry/backoff and track paid/unpaid per leaf in the durable journal

Add a crash-mid-distribution resume test: kill the worker after N of M leaves are paid, restart, confirm it resumes without double-payment attempts (or safely no-ops on retry since payEntitlement itself reverts EntitlementAlreadyPaid)
acceptance: Every committed leaf/chunk gets paid exactly once
A crash resumes without a double-payment attempt succeeding (protected both by the worker's own journal and the contract's own revert)
notes: Idempotent by construction at the contract layer; the journal-level idempotency is a defense-in-depth, not the only guard.
